name: Shading and Frame Buffer Filling
aliases: Packet Ray Casting with Lambertian Shading
Shading and Frame Buffer Filling — Simple Lambertian shading with no shadows is used for fast ray casting of the isosurface.
Simple Lambertian shading with no shadows
definition: Simple Lambertian shading with no shadows is used for fast ray casting of the isosurface.
summary: Shading and Frame Buffer Filling performs fast, shadow-less Lambertian shading by avoiding deferred normal computation to prevent prohibitive memory costs, while aggregating rays into packets to exploit parallelism.
